builder_fields.help_text: Indicates whether this is a brand-new application or an existing offline unit being brought online.
The nature of the business proposal - New Project, Expansion, Diversification, Modernization, or Closure.
The unique CAF ID of an existing approved project, required when applying for expansion or modification.
The legally registered name of the company or business entity as per official incorporation documents.
The primary economic activity whether the project is Manufacturing or providing a Service.
The legal structure of the business entity, such as Private Limited, LLP, Partnership, or Public Limited.
The 10-character Permanent Account Number of the company as issued by the Income Tax Department.
The unique 21-character Corporate Identification Number allotted by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
The 7-character Limited Liability Partnership Identification Number assigned by MCA to LLP entities.
Indicates whether the company holds a valid GST registration under the Goods and Services Tax system.
The 15-character GST Identification Number (GSTIN) assigned to the company for indirect tax purposes.
The official date on which the company or business entity was legally incorporated or registered.
The date on which the company first started its business operations after incorporation.
Indicates whether the company is recognized as a startup under the Government of India's Startup India policy.
The first line of the company's registered corporate office address, including building name or number.
The second line of the corporate office address, such as street name or area (optional).
The country in which the company's corporate office is located.
The Indian state where the company's corporate office is situated.

The city or town name where the corporate office is located.
The 6-digit postal PIN code of the corporate office address.
The STD trunk-dialing code for the landline at the corporate office.
The landline telephone number of the company's corporate office.
The international dialing country code for the corporate contact number (e.g., +91 for India).
The official mobile contact number of the company's corporate office.
The official email address of the corporate office for all correspondence.
Check this if the mailing address is the same as the corporate office address - auto-copies the fields.

The international dialing code for the correspondence contact number.
The mobile contact number associated with the correspondence address.
The email address for receiving official correspondence and government communications.

The full legal name of the promoter or founder as per their PAN card.
The role or title of the promoter in the company, such as Director, Partner, or Proprietor.
The gender of the promoter, used to determine eligibility for gender-based government benefits.
The social category (SC/ST/OBC/General) of the promoter for government classification and benefit eligibility.
The 10-character Permanent Account Number of the individual promoter.
The 12-digit Aadhaar identity number of the promoter for verification and storage.
The date of birth of the promoter as per official government identity documents.
The mobile phone number of the promoter for contact, OTP, and communication purposes.
The email address of the promoter for receiving official communications from the portal.
The percentage shareholding or ownership stake held by this promoter in the company.
The 8-digit Director Identification Number of the promoter, required if they are a company director.
The proposed name of the factory or industrial unit to be established at the project site.
The 5-digit National Industrial Classification (NIC 2008) code identifying the industry's economic activity.
The scale classification of the unit - Micro, Small, Medium, Large, Mega, Ultra Mega, or Super Mega.

builder_fields.custom_label: Products Or Services To Be Manufactured
builder_fields.help_text: A brief description of the products to be manufactured or services to be provided by this industrial unit.
Indicates whether the applicant already has a registered Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise unit.
The unique Udyam registration number (UDYAM-XX-00-0000000) of the existing MSME unit.
Indicates whether the proposed industrial process generates pollution requiring environmental authority clearance.
The environmental pollution category (Red/Orange/Green/White) as classified by KSPCB/CPCB for this industry.
The district in Karnataka where the proposed industrial project will be set up.
The taluk within the selected district where the project site is situated.
The hobli (revenue circle subdivision) within the taluk of the project site.
The village or locality name of the proposed project site.
The industrial zone classification of the project area as per Karnataka Industrial Policy incentive zones.
The first line of the full address of the proposed factory or project site.
The second line of the project site address (optional).
The 6-digit postal PIN code of the proposed project site.
The name of the industrial area, KIADB estate, or SEZ in which the project is located, if applicable.
The current ownership or acquisition status of the land - Owned, Leased, Rented, Government Allotted, etc.
The authority or source from which the project land is obtained, such as KIADB, SIIDCUL, or Revenue.
The total area of land required for the proposed industrial project, expressed in acres.

builder_fields.custom_label: Built Up Area Required In Sq Ft
builder_fields.help_text: The total built-up or constructed area required for the project buildings and infrastructure, in square feet.
The official land survey number or katha number from Karnataka revenue records for the project parcel.
The area of the existing plant or facility in acres, required for expansion or modernization proposals.
The proposed capital expenditure for land purchase or acquisition, expressed in Indian Rupees (Lakhs).
The planned investment in building construction and civil infrastructure, in INR Lakhs.
The planned investment in plant, machinery, and production equipment, in INR Lakhs.
Investment in other fixed assets such as furniture, vehicles, and tools not included above, in INR Lakhs.
Auto-calculated sum of land, building, plant & machinery, and other fixed asset investments, in INR Lakhs.
The estimated funds needed for day-to-day business operations after commissioning, in INR Lakhs.
Auto-calculated total - sum of total fixed capital investment and working capital, in INR Lakhs.
Value of existing fixed assets (VFA) before the proposed expansion or modernization, in INR Lakhs.
The Foreign Direct Investment component of the project, if any, in INR Lakhs.
The country or foreign entity from which the Foreign Direct Investment is being sourced.
The amount contributed from the promoters' own funds or equity capital for the project, in INR Lakhs.
The term loan amount from a bank or financial institution to finance the project, in INR Lakhs.

builder_fields.custom_label: Name Of Bank Or Financial Institution
builder_fields.help_text: The name of the bank or NBFC that is providing the term loan for the project.
The government subsidy or grant component in the project financing, in INR Lakhs.
Any additional financing source not covered by equity, loan, or subsidy, in INR Lakhs.
A brief description of the other financing source, such as venture capital or internal accruals.
Auto-calculated total financing - sum of equity, bank loan, subsidy, and other sources, in INR Lakhs.
The total water consumption required by the unit per day, measured in Kilo Litres per Day (KLD).
The primary source from which water will be procured - e.g., Urban Jal Sansthan, Boring, River, or Canal.
A description of the alternative water source when 'Other' is selected as the source.
The volume of water required specifically for industrial manufacturing processes, in KLD.
The volume of water required for domestic and sanitary use within the facility, in KLD.
The total electrical power requirement of the unit, measured in Kilo Volt Amperes (KVA).
The total connected electrical load of all machinery and equipment in the plant, in Kilowatts.
The primary electricity supply source - such as ESCOM grid connection or captive generator.
A description of the alternative power source when 'Other' is selected as the source.
The percentage of total power requirement that will be met from renewable energy sources.
Number of direct male employees. Direct employees after the unit reaches full commissioning.
Number of direct female employees. Direct female employees after the unit reaches full commissioning.
Auto-calculated: Male + Female direct employment.
Number of skilled employees among total direct employment.
Number of employees who are Karnataka state domicile. Employment domiciles of Karnataka state among the total workforce.
Number of employees from the local district. Employment from the project's local district.
Estimated indirect/ancillary employment generated.
The types of government incentives

builder_fields.custom_label: Whether Applying For Social Category Benefit
builder_fields.help_text: Indicates whether the investor is seeking government benefits reserved for specific social categories.
The specific social category (SC, ST, Benefit Women, OBC) for which the social category benefit is claimed.
Indicates if the project is within Tumakuru Machine Tool Park, which triggers mandatory state-level approval.
Any additional remarks or details about the government assistance or incentives being applied for.
Upload a scanned copy of the company's PAN card issued by the Income Tax Department (PDF/JPG, max 2MB).
Upload the Aadhaar card of the authorized signatory for identity verification (PDF/JPG, max 2MB).
Upload the MCA Certificate of Incorporation or the business registration certificate (PDF/JPG, max 5MB).
Upload the GST registration certificate issued by the GST authority (PDF/JPG, max 2MB).
Upload the land ownership or lease document - title deed, sale deed, RTC / patta, or RTC (PDF/JPG, max 10MB).
Upload the complete Detailed Project Report (DPR) covering technical, financial, and operational plans (PDF, max 10MB).

builder_fields.custom_label: Bank Statement Or Net Worth Certificate
builder_fields.help_text: Upload the latest 6-month bank statement or a CA-certified net worth certificate (PDF/JPG, max 5MB).
Upload the registered partnership deed, required for firms with a partnership constitution (PDF/JPG, max 5MB).
Upload a recent passport-size photograph of the primary promoter (JPG/PNG format, max 1MB).
Upload the Udyam registration certificate if the applicant is an existing MSME (PDF/JPG, max 2MB).
Upload the approval letter of the prior CAF, required for expansion, diversification, or modernization proposals (PDF/JPG, max 5MB).
Upload any other relevant supporting document for the application (optional, PDF/JPG, max 5MB).
